# New Era Exclusive — Interior Design & Renovation, Dubai

> New Era Exclusive is a premium interior design and renovation company based in Dubai, UAE. Over 20 years of expertise in luxury residential and hospitality interiors across the UAE.

## About

New Era Exclusive delivers turnkey interior design and renovation — from concept and engineering to construction, furniture and final handover. One team handles everything: architects, designers and engineers with European education and international experience.

## Services

- Turnkey renovation (end-to-end, all permits included)
- Interior design (concept, 3D visualisation, design supervision)
- AC & climate systems (supply, installation, commissioning)
- Smart home (lighting, climate, security, AV — one interface)
- Furniture & decor (premium sourcing from global suppliers)
- Parametric design (custom furniture and architectural elements)
- Pre-sale & handover preparation
- Permits & documentation (fully managed)

## Exclusive Products (Catalog)

- Flexible Marble — ultra-thin natural stone panels that bend and wrap curved surfaces; certified for fireplaces, facades, pools and bathrooms
- Bespoke Chandeliers — hand-crafted from natural porcelain, Swarovski crystals and fibre-optic elements; designed for specific ceiling height and room volume
- Soft Wall Panels — acoustic panels in premium fabrics (linen, velvet, bouclé, leather); installed in hours, no dust, no drilling
- Smart Toilets — fully automated touchless sanitary systems; floor-standing and wall-mounted configurations
- Smart Ceiling Dryers — warm-air convection drying with HEPA filtration and UV sterilisation; compliant with UAE balcony-drying regulations

## Key Facts

- 20+ years in the UAE market
- 100+ completed projects (villas, penthouses, hotels, restaurants)
- Significant projects under NDA at client request
- Portfolio shown in person upon request
- Single point of accountability — no handoffs between contractors
